subject: perform qtl analysis for multiple traits

messages.author: 82933c06b1097cc4
messages.subject: perform qtl analysis for multiple traits
parts:
Hi,
I have a set of >50 traits, is there a way to perform (at least scanone) with an R syntax instead of input the R code for each trait? Would be even better of the scantwo and all permutations could be done the same way!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] perform qtl analysis for multiple traits
parts:
out <- scanone(mycross, pheno=2:51, method="hk")
operm <- scanone(mycross, pheno=2:51, method="hk", n.perm=1000)

scantwo is a pain; you can write the same thing, but it'll take forever and suck up all of the RAM in the universe.
But if you're doing Haley-Knott regression, try scanonepermhk()

out2 <- scantwo(mycross, pheno=2:51, method="hk") # produces a REALLY large object
operm2 <- scantwopermhk(mycross, pheno=2:51, n.perm=100)

karl
